declared_status: CONFIRMATORY — randomized, pre-registered before any Stage-2 row exists (protocol §6d/§9/§13)

purpose: stream instantiation + determinism check (recorded, reproducible from the seed alone)
entropy reserved for the staged-analysis reference seed; no design quantity is drawn at generation time — the seed table and the parity assignment are fully determined by the protocol formulas

algorithm: For each PERMUTATION REPLICA r = 1..100000, in this fixed draw order:
for stratum s = 1..16 (environment index, pairs (s-1)*50+1 .. s*50):
for j = 1..50 (network index within the stratum), in ascending order:
draw u = rng(); if u < 0.5 flip the sign of that pair's paired difference
(equivalently: an independent random sign per pair, which is exact for a
paired design under the sharp null of no arm effect within the pair),
then recompute the stratum-balanced mean paired difference for the contrast.
Statistic: |mean over pairs of the (possibly flipped) paired difference|,
One rng stream per contrast run, seeded makeRng(seed) with seed below, each
contrast (A-D, then A-B, then A-C) consuming a fresh stream in that order.
permutation_reference_drawn_here.note: The streams were DRAWN AND HASHED at registration time, before any Stage-2 row exists (protocol §9). The Stage-2 analysis must consume exactly this draw order; reproducing it must yield these hashes.

randomization.topology_seeds: continue the 7000+ stream after the §6c reserve: topologySeed = 7008 + k, k = 1..800 → 7009..7808

pilot_overlap_disclosure.note: The §6d basis/stride is protocol-fixed and the pilot (§6c, exploratory) was drawn on nearby anchors; the overlap is disclosed here rather than silently re-based.
pilot_overlap_disclosure.identicalEnvironmentSeeds: pilot environmentSeeds are 4101+100*(k-1) (4101..4801); Stage-2 uses 4101+101*(i-1) (4101..5616). The value 4101 is shared by pilot pair k=1 and Stage-2 envIndex 1.
pilot_overlap_disclosure.identicalNetworkSeeds: pilot networkSeeds 9201,9302,9403 (pairs 1-3) are exactly Stage-2 networkIndex 1,2,3 of every stratum.
pilot_overlap_disclosure.consumedPilotCells: 3 exploratory cells (pilot pairs 1-3). Stage-1 is declared EXPLORATORY with no inferential claims and no p-values (protocol §7); no pilot value enters the Stage-2 estimand, and the confirmatory analysis consumes only Stage-2 rows. If strict pilot/Stage-2 cell disjointness is required, that is a protocol amendment (re-base), not a silent edit here.
pilot_overlap_disclosure.pilotSeedsReserved: §6c rows 4-8 (topology 7004-7008 included) remain reserved; Stage-2 topology seeds start at 7009 and consume none of them.

runtime.runtime_coercion_trap: benchmark.js (57 pinned) builds the arm-D edge list with `arm.swapFactor || 10`, so any FALSY swapFactor silently becomes 10. Measured in the 2026-10-09 dry run: with swapFactor 0 the no-op diagnostic arm produced rows byte-identical to arm D's on the same pair. The config therefore uses a negative swapFactor for the no-op arm and keeps this disclosure next to it.

estimand.dispersion: sample SD, ddof = 1, over per-pair paired differences (pilot report §2 recommendation)

floor_reference.role: instrumentation floor, not a confirmatory contrast

walk_way_entanglement_check.wiring_level: tools/stage2_noop_check.js phase 1: the no-op arm-D list is the REAL 553,807-edge list element-wise (ordered (s,t) sequence, in/out degree sequences, weight/sign multiset, 16-hex wiring fingerprint all identical; invariant across topology seeds)
walk_way_entanglement_check.runtime_level: phase 2 against the dry-run rows: the no-op arm's rows are identical field-by-field to arm A's for the same pair, though the two arms run as separate benchmark.js invocations
walk_way_entanglement_check.rule: any difference at either level voids the A − D interpretation until explained

governance.runner_gate: tools/stage2_parallel.js refuses to run a non-SMOKE config unless this file pins that config's sha256 (exit 2 otherwise). Registration therefore precedes execution by construction as well as by timestamp.
governance.amendment_note: Any change to a pinned file after registration invalidates the pin and requires the §13 amendment path: re-run the §5d match test and the gate-0 checker, regenerate this record, and note the amendment in protocol §0. A new config sha256 is a new registration.
